title: Curly-Haired Young Boy in Garden, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot photo featuring a young boy with dark curly hair standing in a sunny backyard garden. He is dressed in a matching patterned short-sleeve shirt and shorts set paired with striped socks, a popular casual outfit for children in the late 1950s. Dense foliage and flowerbed brick borders frame the background.
